title: FIELDVALUE returns #FIELD! for every non-linked value (even an error first argument) while propagating an error in field_name
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, FIELDVALUE(value, field_name) returns #FIELD! (ERROR.TYPE 11) whenever value is not a linked Stock/Geography data type—including numbers, text, logicals, blank cells, and even worksheet errors such as NA() or 1/0—while returning an error passed in field_name instead (=FIELDVALUE(1/0, NA()) -> #N/A, ERROR.TYPE 7). Arrays lift in dynamic-array formulas and implicitly intersect in legacy formulas. Matches 40/40 full-bank FIELDVALUE rows.
basis: Measured across all 40 full-bank FIELDVALUE rows in Excel 16.0.20527 (CalcFunc-Evidence admit2-answers-fieldvalue-special.json) and 18 formulas in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 (dcb1l_language rows 1-18).
